description: This file contains service functions for managing exercise logs and body metrics in a gym management system, interfacing with a database via SQLAlchemy ORM. It defines functions to create and list exercise logs and body metrics, using database sessions and optional filters.

methods.name: ExerciseLog create_exercise_log(db: Session, user_id: str, payload)
methods.description: Creates a new exercise log entry for a user, commits it to the database, and returns the created log.

methods.name: List[ExerciseLog] list_exercise_logs( db: Session, user_id: str, exercise_id: Optional[int] = None, start_date: Optional[date] = None, end_date: Optional[date] = None, limit: int = 50, offset: int = 0, )
methods.description: Retrieves a list of exercise logs for a user, with optional filtering by exercise, date range, limit, and offset, ordered by date and ID descending.

methods.name: BodyMetrics create_body_metrics(db: Session, user_id: str, payload)
methods.description: Creates a new body metrics snapshot for a user, commits it, and returns the created metrics entry.

methods.name: List[BodyMetrics] list_body_metrics( db: Session, user_id: str, start_date: Optional[date] = None, end_date: Optional[date] = None, limit: int = 50, offset: int = 0, )
methods.description: Retrieves a list of body metrics snapshots for a user, optionally filtered by date range, with pagination, ordered by date and ID descending.
